recognize_zh: CD10 在腫瘤細胞呈弱到中度、完整的細胞膜網狀染色，細胞核大且可見明顯小核仁；表示生發中心 B 細胞（GCB）表現型，雙打擊淋巴瘤多屬此型。
features: Weak to moderate complete membranous CD10 staining in the majority of tumor cells
Large cells with vesicular nuclei and one to several distinct nucleoli visible on the hematoxylin counterstain
Cohesive-appearing sheets with a honeycomb membrane outline
describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry shows weak to moderate, complete membranous staining in the majority of neoplastic cells, producing a honeycomb pattern across diffuse sheets. The counterstained nuclei are large and vesicular with distinct nucleoli. CD10 positivity indicates a germinal center B-cell phenotype, which is the usual immunophenotype of high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, and is also seen in Burkitt lymphoma and GCB-type DLBCL.

ddx.vs: Burkitt is also CD10-positive but is BCL2-negative with a Ki67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement only.
ABC-type DLBCL is CD10-negative and MUM1-positive and rarely carries BCL2 with MYC rearrangement.
MCL is usually CD10-negative and cyclin D1-positive.
